title: Ignore local agent-tool state (Kilo) and guard it from a stray git add
goal: Kilo keeps skills and its own worktrees under .kilo/, which shows as untracked in the primary and could be swept into a commit by git add -A, exactly like the 3390 target files check-tracked-artifacts.sh exists for. Ignore .kilo/ and extend that checker to refuse tracked tool state.
